text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency (Denominations and Characteristics of Coins) (No. 2) Notification 2011
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 27th July 2011 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
DESCRIPTION OF THE 2011 SINGAPORE 46 YEARS OF INDEPENDENCE COINS TO BE ISSUED ON 27TH JULY 2011

The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2011” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the Singapore Arms. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’clock of the proof coin.
The coin design reflects the National Day Parade (NDP) 2011 theme “Majulah! The Singapore Spirit”. The official NDP 2011 logo is at the upper centre of the coin while a mosaic formation of Singapore’s coastline by performers holding coloured cards on the floating platform occupies the bottom half. “The Singapore Spirit”, tagline for the NDP 2011 theme, runs across the mosaic formation. To add to the festive cheer, the diversity of people joining in the celebrations is depicted through human silhouettes at the centre. The newly opened Helix Bridge and the Esplanade Outdoor Theatre are also incorporated in the design to portray the NDP venue surroundings. The denomination is at the upper left, while the words “46 Years of Independence” are on the upper right of the coin.
